purpose: Reusable record of each game publisher's video/monetisation policy for gameplay footage. Production blocks footage whose rights holder matches an entry that disallows use, is unverified or is past its re-verification window. Entries are evidence pointers, not legal advice; the owner verifies each one and records the date.

publishers.conditions: Channel-specific permission is generated on the policy page; keep the written permission for this channel as evidence.
Read the current Game Content Guidelines for online video and image sharing platforms, including what counts as adding creative input and commentary.
